description: This file contains a PHP class 'Affiliate' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Marketing'. The class extends a system Controller and manages affiliate marketing functionalities such as listing affiliates, filtering, sorting, and page navigation for the admin interface.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for managing affiliate-related admin functionalities, including listing, filtering, sorting, and navigation within the affiliate marketing section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the affiliate page in the admin panel, including setting up language, title, filters, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the view output for the list of affiliates.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the affiliates list with filtering and sorting applied.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to save or update affiliate information, including validations for user permissions, affiliate existence, and input data, then responds with JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected affiliates based on user permissions, then returns success or error JSON.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates and updates affiliate balances, generating reports and updating affiliate data, then returns a success JSON.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Generates a CSV payout file for selected affiliates, based on their balance and payment details, and prompts file download with appropriate headers.
